purpose: Add one whole new outcome-blind DEV wave to improve pairable-subject coverage without changing, deleting, relabeling, or rebalancing the frozen original DEV corpus.

wave.name: V5_DEV_EXPANSION_E1
wave.rationale: Use the same size and axis composition as the original DEV roster rather than targeting individual sparse subjects or changing outcome definitions after seeing coverage.

after_wave_rule: Freeze E1 events independently, append original frozen DEV + E1 frozen DEV, then rerun the same necessary-condition and deterministic 1-5y pairing/nuisance gate. Do not weaken thresholds if it fails again.
